Telakaṭāhagāthā
Bud. Pāli. 98 verses. Said to be uttered by a. Arhat Kalyāṇiya thrown into boiling oil by Kalani Tissa [Page208-b] of Kelaniya. See B. C. Law. His.. of Pali Lit. p. 622. Colombo D. I. 1534. 1535.
Pt.. JPTS. 1884, p.. 49-68.

Telkurāya
son of Śiṅgayadeśika of Pulpāka family an. Vāmanāmbā.
--Nidānayogaratnāvalī. med. MD. 13164.
